task.question: Who won the Archibald Prize on May 8, 2026?
task.evidence: May 8 – Richard Lewer wins the Archibald Prize for his portrait of the Pitjantjatjara elder and artist Iluwanti Ken.

answer: The winner of the Archibald Prize on May 8, 2026, was Richard Lewer. FINAL: Richard Lewer

The award, considered Australia’s top portrait honor, is presented annually in recognition of the best portrait of an individual “distinguished in art, letters, science or politics” painted by an Australian resident.
